info.title: API.SH: Resident Advisor
info.description: The Resident Advisor API from API.SH: public Resident Advisor data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Resident Advisor event: title, description, date and times, lineup, artists, genres, venue with address and coordinates, promoters, ticket tiers (title, price, currency, on sale or sold out, on-sale window), lowest and highest price on sale, minimum age, attending count, images, and the full record in `raw`. Pass `id` or `url`, or `area` to get the most popular event there in the next two weeks.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ra-event

parameters.name: area

get.description:
Resident Advisor event listings in an area between two dates (this week by default), with genre filter and sort by date or popularity. Each event has title, date, start and end time, venue, artists, genres, attending count, flyer, cost, minimum age and RA Pick. Also `total` and the genre counts for the search. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ra-events

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: RA area id (13) or name (london, berlin, new york); see /ra/v1/areas.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Last date (YYYY-MM-DD, a week from date_from by default).

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre values, comma-separated (techno, house, deephouse, drumandbass ...; see `genres` in the response).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events per page (20 by default, up to 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Resident Advisor for events, artists, clubs, promoters, labels and areas (and optionally news, reviews, features and podcasts). Each result: type, id, name, link, image, area and country; events add the date, start time and club. Use the id or link with /ra/v1/event, /ra/v1/club, /ra/v1/promoter or /ra/v1/artist.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ra-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only these result types, comma-separated: event, artist, club, promoter, label, area, news, review, feature, podcast (default: event, artist, club, promoter, label, area).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
